scope: Evidence ledger for calibration, not manufacturing certification or publication approval.

sources.kind: local product specification with dated owner decisions
sources.limitation: Internally contradictory and contains claims inferred from third-party photography; not a supplier specification.

sources.excerpt: The identity, material and scene blocks in this skill are STALE
sources.interpretation: Use correction header, product truth and latest owner-selected master; do not paste stale verbatim blocks.

sources.inspection: Viewed directly at 1600px tool resolution. Dark chocolate body, warmer brown straps, upright rolled handles, warm gold front hardware, inward strap tips and no visible brand logo. Visual reference only; cannot establish tanning process or real product performance.

sources.excerpt: is the ONE master seed for every Vivienne generation

sources.limitation: Confirms what the storefront advertises, not independent proof of materials, reviews, scarcity or durability.

claims.claim: The Vivienne Top Handle Bag from Velantra

claims.recheck: On publication day; show pre-order status alongside purchase CTA.

claims.hard_constraint: Do not say ships now, in stock, immediate delivery or guarantee an exact arrival date.

claims.claim: Large top-handle silhouette, two rolled handles, contrasting brown straps on Chocolate, brass-tone closure, braided trim, no visible logo
claims.limitation: Appearance is supported; do not infer material composition or functional operation from a generated still.

claims.claim: Detachable shoulder strap; top handles for hand or elbow carry
claims.limitation: Master does not show the long strap. Shoulder carry must use an approved long-strap reference, never lengthen the short handles.

Truth admits no supplier sheet; tanning method and all-panel composition cannot be established from photographs. Omit in first calibration copy unless relying explicitly on brand specification, and never present as independent tested proof.

claims.claim: Soft/slouchy, matte-to-satin grain body with smoother trim
claims.limitation: Matches current written specification and master appearance. Not independently tested softness or long-term behavior. Older skill instructions for rigid high-gloss structure are explicitly stale.

claims.hard_constraint: No laptop size, capacity, packing volume or fits-everything assertion; use only as approximate design scale if needed.

claims.claim: Lining, pocket configuration, internal zipper and organization
claims.hard_constraint: No generated interior, packing demonstration or specific pocket claim.

precedence_and_conflicts.conflict: Generic older Birkin-name bans versus current user brief
precedence_and_conflicts.resolution: Current user explicitly requests Birkin-dupe angle for Vivienne. Allow this angle in copy review; do not fail solely for Birkin wording. Do not claim affiliation, exact equivalence or identical craftsmanship.

precedence_and_conflicts.conflict: Skill stale structured/high-gloss/all-dimensions-unconfirmed blocks versus its correction header and truth
precedence_and_conflicts.resolution: Correction header delegates to current truth and master. Old blocks are excluded from prompt compilation.

precedence_and_conflicts.conflict: Truth initially calls TikTok supreme, but latest owner choice appoints own Sept 3 master and replaces source hardware
precedence_and_conflicts.resolution: Use latest own master for visible design. TikTok supports source-product understanding only, never ours or publishable material.

precedence_and_conflicts.conflict: Truth hardware paragraph says strap tails fall at side edges; dated Sept 3 correction says inward
precedence_and_conflicts.resolution: Sept 3 rule and actual master govern: inward tails, upright handles.

precedence_and_conflicts.conflict: PDP contains one-finish language despite two-texture truth; verified-buyer quote despite pre-order first run; generic delivery timing beside October pre-order
precedence_and_conflicts.resolution: Do not treat inherited storefront prose as independent evidence. Use expected October, skip testimonial and material-performance claims.

precedence_and_conflicts.conflict: Gallery has Black/Olive visuals while truth says strap treatment unconfirmed
precedence_and_conflicts.resolution: Use Chocolate for first calibration; other color manufacturing details remain unresolved.

hard_failures: Invented personal ownership, testing duration, compliments, purchase, sales counts, review ratings, scarcity deadlines or customer testimonial.
Interior, capacity, laptop fit, leather origin, certifications, same-factory or same-quality-as-Hermes claims without evidence.
Generated B-roll presented as real product testing or footage of a delivered customer unit.
Third-party TikTok/reference footage inserted into publishable output without rights evidence.
Handle/strap/hardware drift, duplicate lock, silver hardware, logo mutation or impossible transparent cutouts.
Wrong fulfillment claim, guaranteed October arrival or unsupported urgency.
